description: Publishes an update on every published status page that shows the incident's monitor and in their RSS and Atom feeds, and on Pro plans emails those pages' subscribers. States: investigating, identified, monitoring, resolved. Write for the page's visitors. Free.

message.description: The update's text, as the pages' visitors read it.

state.description: Where the work on the incident stands; the pages show it with the update.

title.description: Optional title on the pages, such as "Slow checkout".

name: post_incident_update
title: Post a status page update
